steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the fresh pipeline; verify single entry-point node
Step 2 — Select "Webhook" from the Trigger dropdown
Step 3 — Verify the Webhook settings modal opens with all required elements (waiting for the delayed field wave to settle)
Step 3b — Verify the Secret Value eye toggle actually reveals the real secret
Step 4 — Switch Webhook Type to GitLab; verify URL and description update
Step 5 — Switch Webhook Type to Custom; verify URL updates
Step 6 — Click "Apply"; verify modal closes and Trigger shows "Webhook"
Step 7 — Save is a no-op (disabled); reload; verify the Webhook trigger persists
